intro.title: The rest of the body
intro.body: The A1 health pack gave you the obvious parts — head, hand, leg. These are the six the doctor actually asks about, plus six words for what happens when something goes wrong and someone puts it right.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: tongue is the thing in your mouth here, not a language. nail is the one on your finger, not the one you hit with a hammer.
intro.note_cz: Pozor: tongue = jazyk v ústech, ne řeč. nail = nehet, ne hřebík.
